title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Generate barcode through external services/APIs (Telepen, Swiss QR Code, QR codes with colors, images or text……)
summary: Business Central includes built-in barcode functionality via the System Application, supporting 1D and 2D barcodes in reports. When custom formatting like colors, sizes, or embedded images is needed, external APIs like QuickChart can generate QR codes and other barcode types through HTTP requests in AL code.
key_points: Standard barcode module supports one-dimensional and two-dimensional formats (QR, Aztec, Data Matrix, PDF417) natively in BC19.1 and BC18
External APIs enable advanced customization unavailable in standard functionality, such as colored QR codes, custom sizing, embedded center images, and captions
QuickChart API allows QR code generation with parameters for color, margins, error correction level, format (PNG/SVG), and optional center images or text captions
Multiple barcode types supported through external services include QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, Telepen, Swiss QR Code, EAN, UPC, and 40+ others
Implementation uses AL HttpClient to call external API URLs and import the generated barcode image into Item Picture fields or media fields
features: Center image embedding in QR codes

quotes.text: The barcode functionality lets you convert an alphanumeric value in a report dataset into a barcode on a generated report.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the standard barcode capability baseline in Business Central before discussing external API enhancements

quotes.text: If the customer requires a QR code in a special format, such as a special size, background color, etc., the standard cannot do it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the limitation of built-in functionality and the use case for external APIs
